collection.name: materialDuctility
collection.doc: 🧪 Elongation at failure and ultimate strain of a steel material (EN 1993-1-1 3.2.2): the values of the material certificate that, with f_u/f_y, decide whether a material is ductile enough for plastic global analysis.

fields.name: material_id
fields.doc: 🧪 Id of the steel material the certificate values belong to.

fields.name: elongation
fields.doc: 📏 Elongation at failure of the material as a fraction (0.15 = 15 %).

fields.name: ultimate_strain
fields.doc: 📏 Strain eps_u at the ultimate strength f_u as a fraction.
